steps.name: Verify required rig contract execution
steps.run_source:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

evidence = Path("target/rig-contracts")
revision = (evidence / "revision.txt").read_text().strip()
if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", revision) or revision != os.environ["EXPECTED_RIG_REVISION"]:
    raise SystemExit("Recorded rig revision does not match the required PR head")
required = [
    "rig", "autoresolve", "contact-defense", "mhr", "strategic-bootstrap",
    "geometry-admission", "geometry-doc", "native-iteration",
    "camera", "equipment-chronology", "equipment-mapping",
    "animation", "audio", "weather-audio", "animation-reports", "equipment", "maneuver-consumers",
    "creator-armor-frames", "creator-clothing",
    "creator-device-frames", "creator-gorget-bib",
    "creator-gorget-collar", "creator-wrapped-tasset",
    "creator-export", "creator-garment",
    "creator-runtime-equipment", "creator-skin-rules",
    "creator-torso-domain", "creator-underlayer-design",
    "creator-character-morphs", "creator-animation-preview",
    "creator-device-bracer", "creator-device-breastplate",
    "terrain-scene",
    "terrain-scene-input",
    "terrain-scene-coordinates",
    "terrain-grounding",
    "terrain-server-gates",
    "terrain-landforms",
    "terrain-erosion",
    "terrain-extraction",
    "terrain-presentation",
    "terrain-strategic",
    "terrain-viewer",
    "terrain-art-demo",
    "terrain-dispatcher",
    "terrain-inspection",
    "terrain-animation-capture",
]
cells = []
for label in required:
    log = evidence / f"{label}.log"
    text = log.read_text() if log.is_file() else ""
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]", "", text)
    results = re.findall(
        r"^test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;",
        text, re.MULTILINE,
    )
    passed, failed, ignored = (
        sum(int(result[index]) for result in results)
        for index in range(3)
    )
    cells.append({
        "cell": label, "log": str(log), "revision": revision,
        "passed": passed, "failed": failed, "ignored": ignored,
        "accepted": bool(results) and passed > 0 and failed == 0,
    })
(evidence / "required-cells.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(cells, indent=2) + "\n"
)
missing = [cell["cell"] for cell in cells if not cell["accepted"]]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing or empty required test results: {missing}")
PY
